nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a commutative semiring, let $R$ be a commutative ring that is a $K$-algebra, and let $(I_i)_{i \in \iota}$ be a family of ideals of $R$ indexed by a finite type $\iota$ that are pairwise coprime, that is, $I_i + I_j = R$ for $i \ne j$. Then the map sending the class of $r \in R$ to $(r \bmod I_i)_{i \in \iota}$ is an isomorphism of $K$-algebras from $R / \bigcap_i I_i$ to $\prod_i R / I_i$.
nodes.title: Chinese remainder theorem as an algebra isomorphism

nodes.summary: Let $K$ and $K'$ be fields with $K'$ a $K$-algebra, let $f \in K[X]$, and let $(g_i)_{i \in \iota}$ be a family of irreducible polynomials in $K'[X]$, indexed by a finite type $\iota$, that are pairwise non-associated and whose product $\prod_i g_i$ is associated (equal up to a unit) to the image of $f$ in $K'[X]$. Then there is an isomorphism of $K'$-algebras
nodes.title: Base change of $K(X)/(f)$ along a factorization of $f$ over $K'$
